invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2315（基于当前价格微调，约-0.1%），或融资费率Z-score降至<50%（多头压力缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格<SMA50 $2101.14）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2315 (slightly adjusted from current price, ~-0.1%), or funding Z-score falls to <50% (long pressure eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 $2101.14).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破73000（基于ATR 491.78调整，约-1.8%），或融资费率Z-score转正>50%（空头压力缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格<SMA50），或Qlib评分跌至底部（如<0）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 73000 (adjusted based on ATR 491.78, ~-1.8%), or funding Z-score turns positive >50% (short pressure eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50), or Qlib score falls to bottom (e.g., <0).
